name: (05) Protean — 3 Advanced — Shape of the Beast's Wrath

system.description:
You erupt into a towering war-shape, a monstrous amalgam of yourself and the beast to which you feel closest kinship — wolf, great cat, rat, raven or stranger things still.

Spending two Blood Traits triggers the change over three turns; you may quicken it at one Blood Trait per turn, transforming instantly for five Traits. You grow half again in height and triple in weight, remaining transformed until you revert or until sunrise, whichever comes first. The form (fixed when the power is learned) adds five Physical Traits, an additional Bruised health level, the equivalent of Heightened Senses, and an extra level of aggravated damage from your fangs and claws; the power may be bought repeatedly for further forms. While transformed your Social Traits drop by five (never below one), and you must bid two extra Traits to resist frenzy, with Willpower Traits forbidden in that challenge.
system.bloodCost: Two Blood Traits (or up to five to speed the change)
